Position: Sr. Sales Manager – Walmart/Sam’s Club

Location: Bentonville, Arkansas

Position Summary:

Under the general direction of the VP of Sales and Sr. Director of Sales in the Home Entertainment department, Hisense is looking for a high-performing Sr. Sales Manager to help us meet our growth targets in television and sound bar in Walmart Stores and Sam’s Club. This person will be responsible for meeting television and sound bar sales goals, achieving forecast targets, crafting sell in plans and justifying plans with Hisense upper management and business planning. In addition, they are responsible for formulating innovative business development strategies and providing vision for sales strategies and their execution. This position will be responsible for maximizing marketing, advertising, events, and training budgets while ensuring Hisense is represented as a top leader in the industry.  They will act as the face of the company at various major retailers, while acting as a liaison for Hisense internal departments.

Duties/Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with Sr. Director of Sales to develop short- and long-term strategic plans, including the preparation of annual Business plans and budget

• Heavy involvement in creating and maintaining a 90 and 120-day rolling sell in plan by account

• Conduct weekly and daily sales forecasts and account reviews to create reports and compare against objectives

• Achieving shelf share goals during annual assortment summits by account

• Conduct and help direct weekly/bi-weekly CPFR calls with customers along with business planning

• Manage assigned budgets while consistently seeking revenue and cost optimization

• Negotiate annual vendor program agreements by account while forecasting and tracking associated expenditures

• Manage financial risks as it relates to customer deductions and offsets

• Ensure organization-wide programs and events are administered, representing Hisense as a world class consumer electronics brand

• Manage executive relationships and metrics with key regional accounts including inventory levels, turns, contracts, quarterly corporate business reviews, periodic business reviews, and drive increased sales within the accounts as assigned

• Act as the liaison for assigned customer’s online portals

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• At least 5 years of Sales experience with televisions and sound bars, preferably with Walmart or Sam’s Club

• Experience developing sales forecasts

• Experience with creating innovative business development strategies and providing vision for sales strategies and their execution

Responsibilities:

1. Warehouse Network Planning & Total Cost Optimization

• Lead the assessment of logistics flows among manufacturing facilities, ports, border crossings, warehouses, and customers, and evaluate warehouse locations, service coverage, SKU allocation, and replenishment rules.

• Optimize warehouse nodes and resource allocation, with particular focus on shared warehousing requirements between manufacturing operations in Mexico and local subsidiaries across the region.

• Reduce redundant warehouse locations, unnecessary inter-warehouse transfers, and inefficient handling or transshipment activities.

• Partner with Transportation Management and Logistics Cost Management teams to improve regional network efficiency and reduce total end-to-end logistics costs.

2. Warehouse Space Utilization Optimization

• Partner with the Headquarters Customer Delivery Center to leverage warehouse management best practices from China and other international markets.

• Evaluate racking configurations, stacking methods, storage and operational zoning, and inbound/outbound dock arrangements based on product characteristics, inventory profiles, and seasonal demand fluctuations.

• Improve effective storage capacity and warehouse space utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and product protection requirements.

3. Warehouse Operational Efficiency Improvement

• Analyze effective storage capacity, storage cost per unit of volume, and labor productivity to identify operational bottlenecks within warehouses.

• Optimize storage location assignments, material handling routes, workforce scheduling, and equipment utilization.

• Drive the implementation and replication of proven operational practices across the region to increase warehouse throughput and reduce handling costs per unit and per unit of volume.

4. Warehouse Operating Standards

• Develop and implement standardized regional processes for receiving, put-away, storage location management, cycle counting, picking, verification, loading, and returns.

• Establish product-category-specific requirements for clamp handling, material movement, stacking, and packaging protection based on product and packaging specifications.

• Lead implementation, training, and compliance reviews to reduce handling-related product damage and improve warehouse operational quality.

5. Inter-Warehouse Transfer Management

• Establish inventory allocation principles across warehouses in each country and partner with the Customer Delivery Center, IT, and relevant business teams to continuously improve inventory allocation and replenishment rules.

• Standardize the assessment, approval, and execution process for inter-warehouse transfers.

• Reduce unnecessary transfers caused by inefficient inventory allocation and minimize incremental transportation, handling, and warehousing costs.

6. Category B Inventory Management & Disposition

• Partner with Planning, Finance, R&D, manufacturing facilities, and other relevant functions to define Category B inventory, identification criteria, and ownership responsibilities.

• Establish and improve the end-to-end process for identification, segregation, disposition approval, and clearance, including clear timelines and accountability.

• Work with Sales, Product, and Service teams to execute approved disposition plans and track progress.

• Verify physical inventory disposition, system status updates, and storage capacity release to reduce Category B inventory levels and associated warehouse capacity consumption.

7. Inventory Quality & Outbound Delivery Management

• Strengthen regional inventory management standards and oversee cycle counting, physical-to-system inventory reconciliation, variance investigation, and corrective actions.

• Standardize processes for damage documentation, evidence collection, and claims management.

• Establish requirements for order staging, outbound verification, loading, and handoff to carriers.

• Drive timely and accurate outbound execution across business units and collaborate with Transportation Management to reduce truck waiting time, customer delivery refusals, and warehouse-related customer penalties or chargebacks.

8. Warehouse Service Provider Management & Operational Improvement

• Establish standardized regional evaluation criteria and performance scorecards for third-party logistics providers (3PLs).

• Develop structured processes for corrective actions, resource adjustments, performance improvement, and provider replacement when necessary.

• Lead warehouse efficiency and quality improvement initiatives and validate both on-site execution and measurable operational results.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 7+ years of experience in warehousing and logistics, including at least 3 years of experience in warehouse network planning, third-party logistics (3PL) management, or multi-site warehouse operations. Experience in home appliances, consumer durables, or other bulky-goods warehousing is preferred.

• Strong capabilities in warehouse network planning, storage capacity analysis, warehouse sourcing and bidding, process optimization, and rate/cost analysis, with the ability to evaluate warehouse solutions from both service and cost perspectives.

• Solid knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), inventory counting and control, material handling equipment, operational productivity, and quality management. Experience with warehouse start-ups, relocations, consolidations, or network restructuring projects is preferred.

• Strong data analysis, on-site operational diagnosis, and cross-functional project management skills, with demonstrated ability to implement standardized processes and replicate best practices across multiple operations.

• Professional working proficiency in both Chinese and English. Experience coordinating cross-border operations across the U.S., Mexico, and Canada, or proficiency in Spanish, is preferred.

• Ability and willingness to travel to warehouses and manufacturing facilities across the region as business needs require to conduct operational assessments, diagnostics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
